terms.nextSteps: Review this proposal with marketing, IT, and finance stakeholders. When ready, accept the proposal so Kreate by Design can prepare the final agreement for signature.
terms.exclusions: CMS integration, Magento or other platform integration, production deployment, back-end implementation, hosting, Find Your Filter, and third-party fees unless explicitly listed in the signed agreement.
terms.proposalTerms: This proposal defines the creative engagement, delivery roadmap, investment, and payment schedule for the selected option. Accepting this proposal authorizes Kreate by Design to prepare a final agreement for signature. Acceptance is not a signed contract and does not begin billable work until the agreement is executed and kickoff payment is received.
terms.expirationLanguage: This proposal is valid through November 6, 2026. After that date, scope, schedule, and investment may be revised.
terms.paymentAssumptions: Investment is billed in three installments: 40% at contract execution and kickoff, 30% upon approved creative direction and delivery of agreed primary templates, and 30% upon delivery of final agreed creative assets, source materials, documentation, and completion of the contractual review process. Amounts are shown in the payment schedule and align to the total project investment.
terms.cancellationSummary: Cancellation and pause terms will be defined in the final agreement, including treatment of work in progress and payments due for completed phases.
terms.timelineAssumptions: The delivery roadmap in this proposal is the authoritative phase schedule. Dates assume timely kickoff, K&N content and brand assets, consolidated feedback from K&N's designated project owner, and approvals within agreed review windows. If kickoff or approvals shift, dates will be re-baselined in writing. K&N IT owns production integration, testing, and deployment; this schedule does not represent a production launch date.
terms.acceptanceDisclosure: If you approve this proposal, Kreate by Design will prepare the final agreement based on the accepted scope, pricing, and options. Approving this proposal is not a signed contract.
terms.changeRequestLanguage: Each major approval stage includes up to two consolidated revision rounds, submitted by K&N's designated project owner within the review window for that stage. Feedback must be consolidated; fragmented or conflicting direction may reset the review clock. Changes to approved scope, substantial redesigns beyond agreed revisions, additional pages, new functionality, or new template families require written change approval and may adjust investment and schedule.
terms.clientResponsibilities: K&N will provide approved copy, product information, and brand assets; designate a single project owner to consolidate feedback; meet agreed review windows; and confirm with K&N IT the approved editable-source and handoff format (including Figma or code repository standards). K&N IT owns CMS integration, production development, testing, deployment, and launch.
terms.operationalDraftNotice: Template and operational wording only. Not attorney-approved legal advice. Matt must review all contract language before sharing or signature.
terms.contractRequiredDisclosure: Work begins after the final agreement is signed and the kickoff payment is received.
terms.intellectualPropertySummary: Upon full payment, K&N receives ownership of paid custom deliverables created specifically for this engagement (designs, documentation, and Option B reference source artifacts identified in the agreement), subject to third-party license terms for embedded fonts, stock, or software. Kreate by Design retains ownership of its pre-existing frameworks, reusable utilities, internal tools, and background intellectual property; K&N receives a license to use those elements only as embedded in the delivered work. Third-party components remain subject to their respective licenses. If K&N's formal SOW or procurement terms require different ownership or work-for-hire language, those terms must be reviewed and agreed in the final contract before signature.

executive.objectives: Deliver an approved creative direction as working templates and components, with staging review and source documentation, so K&N IT can implement against a known front-end reference.
executive.desiredOutcomes: IT receives organized source, demonstrated interactions, and phased releases aligned to the roadmap, without assuming unlimited revision or production deployment by Kreate by Design.
executive.currentSituation: IT needs inspectable, responsive reference implementation alongside marketing-grade creative direction, without conflating reference code with production CMS work.
executive.executiveSummary: Kreate by Design will build a Next.js/React interactive front-end reference for the full in-scope creative program (~38 pages, template families, two directions, design system, technical graphics) with rolling handoffs through December 2026. This is a front-end reference and documentation package, not production platform integration, Magento compatibility, or back-end implementation.
executive.clientFacingIntro: K&N Global Filtration is modernizing its enterprise web presence with a disciplined template architecture and a code-first reference that helps IT see real responsive behavior before production integration. K&N IT owns CMS integration, deployment, and launch. Approved handoff packages can be implemented while remaining creative work continues.
executive.recommendedDirection: Option B pairs the same enterprise creative scope with a Next.js/React reference implementation, reusable components, private staging review, and rolling repository handoffs. Production integration remains K&N IT's responsibility and requires IT approval of the handoff format.

scopeGroups.title: Delivery roadmap (November–December 2026)
scopeGroups.overview: Six roadmap phases below. Phases 3 and 4 run in parallel so K&N IT can implement approved homepage and priority template families while KXD continues remaining-page creative work and rolling handoffs. Dates are targets contingent on timely kickoff, materials, consolidated feedback, and approvals. KXD does not control K&N production launch, CMS integration, or deployment.

deliverables.title: Roadmap Phase 1 — Discovery and two creative directions (Nov 2–13)
deliverables.description: KXD: discovery, ~38-page template-family architecture, two distinct creative directions. K&N: stakeholders, content, brand assets, consolidated feedback. IT: optional technical input. Gate: both directions presented and reviewed.

deliverables.title: Roadmap Phase 2 — Direction approval (Nov 16–20)
deliverables.description: KXD: refine selected direction and approval package. K&N: select direction and approve in writing. IT: direction pack and template plan. Gate: creative direction approved.

deliverables.title: Roadmap Phase 3 — Homepage, priority templates, design system, initial handoff (Nov 20–Dec 4, parallel)
deliverables.description: KXD: homepage, priority templates, responsive system, first developer handoff. K&N: review within agreed windows. IT: begin implementation from approved homepage/templates. Gate: primary templates approved for IT.

deliverables.title: Roadmap Phase 4 — Remaining pages, interactions, graphics, rolling handoffs (Nov 23–Dec 18, parallel)
deliverables.description: KXD: remaining template-family pages, interactions, technical graphics, rolling handoffs. K&N: rolling content and batch approvals. IT: receive approved packages as released. Gate: in-scope template families approved (Find Your Filter excluded).

deliverables.title: Roadmap Phase 5 — Creative scope review (Dec 18)
deliverables.description: KXD: consolidated scope review. K&N: executive review and punch-list. IT: alignment on integration queue. Gate: scope review accepted.

deliverables.title: Roadmap Phase 6 — Final revisions and handoff (Dec 21–31)
deliverables.description: KXD: agreed revisions, final assets, documentation, final handoff. K&N: consolidated revision feedback. IT: final source and documentation. Gate: creative handoff acknowledged (not production launch).

scopeGroups.estimatedTimeline: Creative handoff targeted by end of December 2026.

scopeGroups.title: Option B — Next.js/React reference and code-first handoff
scopeGroups.overview: Interactive front-end reference and source for K&N IT to implement; not production deployment.
